_comment: AUTHORITATIVE protocol test vector for the RE sha256-legacy canonical form. RE receipts issued before the Ed25519 cutover at migration 0278 carry signature_algorithm absent or null and are signed over a 13-field form — reCanonical without prior_hash (which did not exist when these receipts were signed). The 6-field otherCanonical form was never issued by any version of the issuer.
_spec: reLegacyCanonical — 13-field sha256-legacy: sort all keys by Unicode code-point order, JSON.stringify compact. Signature is SHA-256_hex(canonical_bytes). Mirror of canonicaliseEngagementReceiptLegacy() in packages/api/src/utils/canonical-receipt.ts.
_note_on_canonical_hex: canonical_sha256 is sha256(canonical_json encoded as UTF-8). The signature of a real receipt is SHA-256_hex(canonical_json) — the sha256 here IS the signature for this form.
